metadata.result_scope: public compact aggregate for 432-episode DeepSeek Flash single-slot main preflight

main_study_contract.primary_hypothesis: R2 improves recoverable-fault SafePass^3 over R1 while preserving clean SafeSuccess within a five-percentage-point noninferiority margin and without adding severe side effects.

single_slot_preflight.formula: 24 tasks × 1 seed × 2 conditions × 3 runtimes × 1 model × 3 trials

limitations: This executes only the strong API slot and is not the two-model confirmatory main.
The API exposes neither an immutable serving-weight hash nor a sampling seed.
The new 16 fixtures have scripted validity evidence but only one model binding so far.
A second exact model binding is required before the 864-episode contract can run.
